eyebrow: Idempotency — the property that matters most
code:
# Idempotent: run twice on the same input,
#              get the SAME result as running once.
#
# Real jobs get retried. A non-idempotent pipeline
# silently corrupts data on the second run.
caption: Easy to miss until it's already happened in production.

eyebrow: Why MERGE, not append, for silver
code:
silver_table = DeltaTable.forName(spark, "silver.trips")
silver_table.alias("target").merge(
  cleaned_new_rows.alias("source"),
  "target.VendorID = source.VendorID AND target.tpep_pickup_datetime = source.tpep_pickup_datetime",
).whenMatchedUpdateAll().whenNotMatchedInsertAll().execute()
caption: append would duplicate rows on a rerun. MERGE is the idempotency mechanism.
